notes: Format-faithful synthetic ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 /studies response pair (page 1 with nextPageToken, page 2 final), scoped to the five module fields the schema needs. Exercises a mapped industry sponsor (Pfizer -> PFE), an unmapped academic sponsor (Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center), a month-precision startDate (mRNA-1230, sponsor ModernaTX Inc. -> MRNA), a no-phase observational study (Massachusetts General Hospital; designModule.phases is absent, not empty), and a study with conditionsModule and primaryCompletionDateStruct both entirely absent (Cleveland Clinic Foundation) — mapping to their honest defaults ([] and null) rather than a guess.
